CAMEL-19994.title: camel-platform-http-vertx - Allow access to vertx request object
CAMEL-19994.description:
In servlet components you can get access to HttpServletRequest. However vertx is not servlet, but it has its own API abstraction.

We should allow end users access to that object instance for advanced use-cases.

We may do as in camel-servlet components to wrap that into a HttpMessage object that has getter for that, instead of using DefaultMessage.

commits.message: CAMEL-19994: camel-platform-http-vertx - Allow access to vertx request object. Add support for pooled exchange like we have in other http components.
commits.author: davsclaus
